name: City Council Regular Meeting Agenda - Supplemental Packet Posted
agenda_text:
KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 10, 2025 - 6:30 p.m.
  .

  ATTEND OR WATCH THE MEETING
  Members of the public may attend in-person in the Council Chambers or watch the meeting
  through Zoom, City Website (Live Stream) or Cable TV Channel 10. City Council Chamber doors
  open 30 minutes before the meeting start time.

  PUBLIC COMMENT/SPEAKERS
  Members of the public may express comments to the City Council in person at the meeting or
  may submit written comments before or at the meeting. Submit a Public Speaker card or Written
  Comment card to the City Clerk prior to the public comment portion of that item. Public speakers
  are limited to three minutes unless the presiding officer sets a different limit for meeting
  management purposes. An oral summary of written comments may be given at the discretion of
  the presiding officer.

  Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than
  4:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
  meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  ZOOM VIEWING ONLY:
  Members of the public watching through Zoom will not have the ability to provide comments on
  agenda items. Zoom is offered strictly as an additional viewing platform. To provide comments,
  see Public Comments/Speakers section.

  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81330233596
  Webinar ID: 813 3023 3596
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,81330233596# OR 16699009128,,81330233596#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 OR +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 253 205 0468
 Unless the City Council holds a teleconference meeting under AB 2449 (2022) guidelines, the
meeting will not be cancelled if technical issues occur.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
Packets.

CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Davis, Pearl,  Halpern,  Mayor  Pro  Tem
  McSweeney, Mayor Honig

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:
APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of July 23, 2025 City Council Regular Meeting

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the City Council on non-agenda items that are within the Council’s
subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit (three minutes unless a different limit is set by the
presiding officer for meeting management purposes). Public Comments may be presented via a written
comment, see Page 1 for deadline. Complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk to be called
to speak while in the Council Chambers.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: Reports on City Council Committee meetings held.

1.  ADMINISTRATIVE COMMITTEE REPORT – REVIEW OF LIGHTING
  ASSESSMENT DISTRICT 1 – Receive the information regarding Lighting
  Assessment District 1 and provide comments and guidance to staff.

2.  ADMINISTRATIVE COMMITTEE REPORT – REVIEW OF INDUSTRIAL WASTE
  PERMIT FEES - Direct staff to send a letter to the County of Los Angeles
  requesting to begin using the 1.5 multiplier, as allowed by current ordinance, with
  an effective date of January 1, 2026 for all Industrial Waste Pemit Fees.
 PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 07-004, MODIFICATION NO. 5;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2412-25 - Adopt Resolution No. 2412-25, determining
  Modification No. 5 of Conditional Use Permit No. 07-004 is exempt from CEQA
  and authorizing a time extension for the continued operation of an indoor baseball
  training facility located at 31285 Via Colinas (Hitting Zone).

  RESOLUTION NO. 2412-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING MODIFICATION NO. 5 OF CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT NO. 07-005 TO AUTHORIZE THE CONTINUED OPERATION OF AN INDOOR
  BASEBALL TRAINING FACILITY LOCATED AT 31285 VIA COLINAS (HITTING ZONE)

2.  CLARIFICATION OF NORTH BUSINESS PARK SPECIFIC PLAN PROHIBITED
  LAND USES; ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 2413-25 APPROVING NORTH
  BUSINESS PARK SPECIFIC PLAN AMENDMENT NO. 25-001 AND
  APPROVING A CEQA EXEMPTION DETERMINATION - Adopt Resolution No.
  2413-25 approving a CEQA exemption determination and adopting North
  Business Park Specific Plan Amendment No. 25-001 to amend Chapters 3 and 4
  of the Specific Plan to clarify prohibited land uses.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2413-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE ADOPTING NORTH BUSINESS PARK SPECIFIC PLAN
  AMENDMENT NO. 25-001 AND APPROVING A CEQA EXEMPTION DETERMINATION

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective August 1, 2025 in the amount
  of $840,877.05; Warrants effective August 15, 2025 in the amount of $383,803.13;
  and Warrants effective September 1, 2024 in the amount of $606,886.25.

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1.  RIGHT OF ENTRY AND ACCESS AGREEMENTS; WEED ABATEMENT
  ON VARIOUS PROPERTIES - Approve a Right of Entry and Access
  Agreement with Bicky Rippe and Jonathon Brewster and authorize the
  Mayor sign and execute the agreements on behalf of the City.

  2.  ADJUSTMENT OF MEDICAL PREMIUM RATES AND EMPLOYER
  CONTRIBUTIONS FOR ACTIVE EMPLOYEES EFFECTIVE JANUARY 1,
  2026; RESOLUTION 2414-25 - Adopt Resolution No. 2414-25, to Amend
  Resolution No. 1564-11 to Increase the Insurance Coverage Benefit for
  Full-Time Active Employees.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2414-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE AMENDING RESOLUTION NO. 1564-11 TO
  INCREASE THE INSURANCE COVERAGE BENEFIT FOR FULL-TIME ACTIVE
  EMPLOYEES
 OLD BUSINESS:

1.  AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE CIVIC CENTER
  COURTYARD FOUNTAINS DEMOLITION PROJECT - Award a construction
  contract for the Courtyard Fountains Demolition Project to Cerco Engineering Inc.
  in the amount of $48,500.00 with contingency of $10,000 and $7,500 in project
  management costs, authorize the Mayor to execute the construction contract on
  behalf of the City, and authorize the City Manager to execute any necessary
  change orders within the contingency amount.

NEW BUSINESS: None

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, September 4, 2025 at 3:30 p.m. on the City’s website
and in the Posting Board at City Hall.

  City Clerk
  September 4, 2025
